brief:
A new initiative called #DroptheGenocide20, reported by Zeteo, is demanding that Biden administration officials involved in Gaza policy not be appointed to positions within liberal institutions and spaces. The campaign specifically targets what organizers characterize as complicity in the Gaza conflict.

The effort draws parallels to JD Vance's own career trajectory, noting that Vance sought roles in liberal circles in 2016 despite his stated opposition to Trump at that time. The campaign reflects ongoing tension within progressive movements over Biden administration officials' involvement in Middle East policy.
dek: #DroptheGenocide20 demands Biden admin aides who enabled the Gaza genocide not be given roles in liberal spaces – like the role it turns out JD Vance pursued in 2016, when he ‘hated’ Trump.
title: Activist group targets Biden officials over Gaza policy with accountability campaign
